text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, March 25 - Chittagong - 21 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 5 general cargo, 4 others, 4 foodgrain, 1 cement clinker, 1 tanker, 1 cement. 27 Vessels due by 1/4 of which 11 containers, 4 general cargo, 2 others, 3 scrap, 3 foodgrain, 1 car carrier, 1 cement clinker, 1 fertiliser, 1 tanker. No berthing delays, port working normally.

INDIA, March 25 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 4-5 days, general cargo 1-2 days. 10 Vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 Under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 26 Vessels due, 7 loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering. Cochin - 13 Vessels due, up to 1 day delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Repairs, 1 tug and 1 small vessel at dock, 1 general cargo at jetty. Chennai (Madras) - 42 Vessels due. Delays expected, coal/coke, fertiliser, others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays for containers and iron ore. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Mormugao - 10 vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at ahorage to discharge, 1 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - 18 Vessels due, 5-6 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 arrested in harbour, 3 tankers. 20 Vessels waiting. Mangalore - Six vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 3 awaiting berth, 1 other. Jawaharlal Nehru - Six vessels due, 2 discharging at berth. Paradip - Six vessels due, 1 day delay expected. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 bunkering.

Tuticorin - Two vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 under repair/drydock. Visakhapatnam - 16 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth.

MAURITIUS, March 25 - Port Louis - Four vessels alongside of which 2 containers, 2 general cargo. Fishing port - 9 Vessels for discharging/bunkering/loading, etc. Port will stop work at 1800 hrs. on 28/3 (Good Friday).

PAKISTAN, March 24 - Karachi - Four vessels due. Delays expected, 2 days for general cargo/containers/rice, 7 days for fertiliser. 7 Vessels loading at berth (rice and molasses), 4 container vessels loading and discharging at berth, 8 vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, urea, phosphate, fuel oil). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load rice, 11 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, containers, crude oil, tallow, urea, sulphur, rock phosphate). 2 Vessels awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Three vessels discharging at berth (palm oil, sugar, wheat), 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load rice. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (soya oil, machinery, palm oil, fuel oil, wheat).

SINGAPORE, March 25 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 7 Containers berthed. Keppel - 9 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 8 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawan - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong - 2 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 21 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, March 25 - Inchon - 66 Vessels in port (41 berthed, 25 anchored) of which 8 logs, 6 general cargo, 4 each steel, containers, 2 each raw sugar, pig iron, plywood, pulp, 1 each talc, silica sand, lupins, molasses, cotton seed meal, coils, corn, cars, fertiliser, soybean, scrap. Anchored, 5 cars, 4 corn, 3 each logs, containers, 2 general cargo, 1 each raw suga pulp, coils, steel, pig iron, wire rods, salt, wheat. Approx. 1 day delay expected. Busan - 147 Vessels in port (37 berthed, 110 anchored including 55 laid up) of which 22 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 55 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1 day delay expected.

Pohang - 32 Vessels in port (21 berthed, 11 anchored) of which discharging, 2 each billets, coils, 1 each pig iron, logs, steel, scrap, slabs. 12 Vessels loading steel, 11 awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 27 Vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 each feed meal, coal, flour, tallow, logs, cement, paraxylene, mono ethyl glycol, raw sugar, mixed xylene, zinc ingots, copper concentrates, rock phosphate, crude oil, ethanol, corn. Loading, 3 general cargo, 2 steel pipes, 1 each fibre, cyclo hexane, styrene monomer, chemicals, naphtha, diesel oil. No berthing delays expected. Masan - Ten vessels berthed of which discharging, 3 scrap, 2 each talc powder, logs, 1 each pulp, tapioca. 1 Vessel loading containers, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, March 25 - Colombo - Vessels due, 5 containers, 1 bagged cement, 2 car carriers. Delays, 24 hours for conventional/container vessels, 9 vessels loading at berth (3 essential services, 6 containers). Discharging at berth, 4 bagged cement, 12 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bulk cement, 1 container/general, 1 bulk mop, 1 bagged flour, 1 bagged onions. 8 Container vessels waiting at anchorage to load. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 containers, 2 bagged cement, 1 container/general, 1 heavy lift (project cargo). 2 Vessels under repair, 4 in drydock, 8 awaiting orders. Galle - One vessel loading at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth.

TAIWAN, March 20 - Fangcheng - Three vessels in port, 1 anchored awaiting berth. Dalian - 20 Vessels in port, 10 anchored awaiting berth. Huangpu - 25 Vessels in port, 2 anchored awaiting berth. Ningbo - Seven vessels in port, 1 anchored awaiting berth. Qingdao - 23 Vessels in port, 15 anchored awaiting berth. Nangtong - Three vessels in port, 1 anchored awaiting berth. Qinhuangdao - 12 Vessels in port, 26 anchored awaiting berth. Shekou, Chiwan, Maw - Five vessels in port. Zhangjiagang - Port working normally, no congestion, vessels berthing on arrival. Shanghai - 23 Vessels in port, 5 anchored awaiting berth.

Yantai - Nine vessels in port, 2 anchored awaiting berth. Zhanjiang - Nine vessels in port, 2 anchored awaiting berth. March 24 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 5 days, steel 4 days, iron ore 3 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Two vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain, iron/coal (CSC berth), steel 1 day, coal/scrap (public berth) 3 days. Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 2 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel others 1 day.
THAILAND, March 26 - Bangkok - 84 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 1 tanker, 78 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 3 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
